course.keep.by.restore: before going back to a version
course.keep.restored: Your unsaved course from {time} is back (Versions: {n} kept). Key Ctrl+Z takes it away.
course.keep.blocked: Drafts are not kept: the browser's site storage is full or blocked. Save the course to keep it.
course.keep.versionsNote: Kept by itself in this browser while you edit (not on other devices).
course.keep.versionsEmpty: No versions yet: they appear after your first change.
course.keep.backDone: Back to the version of {time} ({n} gates). Key Ctrl+Z undoes it.
course.save.problem.rate: Too many new courses from this computer this hour. Your course is kept as a draft. Save again after {time}.
course.save.problem.network: No connection to the site. Your course is kept as a draft. Check the internet and press Save again.
course.save.problem.name: The name needs 2-32 letters or digits; spaces and - _ . ' are allowed. Fix it, then press Save.
course.save.problem.title: The title needs 3-60 letters or digits; spaces and - _ . ' , ! ? # ( ) + : & are allowed. Fix it, then press Save.
course.save.problem.leg: Gates {a} and {b} are more than 60 m apart. Add a gate between them or move them closer, then press Save.
course.save.problem.storage: The site could not store it now. Your course is kept as a draft. Save again in a minute; if it repeats, the Feedback button sends us the details.
course.save.problem.other: The site did not take the course ({msg}). Your course is kept as a draft. Press Save again; if it repeats, the Feedback button sends us the details.
course.fix.looking: Checking the course for small corrections...
course.fix.found.leg: the way from gate {a} to gate {b} touches a wall
course.fix.found.legStart: the way from the start to gate {b} touches a wall
course.fix.offer: Before saving: {what}. Make these small corrections and save?
course.fix.offerSome: Before saving: {what}. Some of it can be corrected for you. Make those small corrections?
course.fix.done.moved: gate {g} moved {cm} cm away from the wall
course.edit.saveWarn.title: Warnings: {n}. You can still save the course as it is.
course.edit.saveWarn.closed: Not saved. Press Save when you are ready.
course.edit.saveWarn.kind.inScan: Inside a wall of the scan (gates: {gates})
course.edit.saveWarn.kind.blockedStart: The start is inside a wall
course.edit.saveWarn.kind.legBlocked: A wall on the way to the gate (gates: {gates})
course.edit.saveWarn.kind.noOrder: The order of the gates is unclear (gates: {gates})
course.edit.saveBlock.noGates: Nothing to save yet: press Add gate and click in the scan to place the first gate.
course.edit.saveBlock.tooManyGates: Too many gates to save: at most {limit}. Delete {extra} of them, then press Save.
course.edit.saveBlock.gateTooBig: Gate {g} is too big to save: at most {limit} m across. Pick a smaller gate, then press Save.
course.edit.saveBlock.legTooLong: The way from gate {a} to gate {b} is longer than {limit} m, more than a course can store. Add a gate between them, then press Save.
course.edit.saveBlock.tooFar: Gate {g} is too far from the scan to save. Pull it back towards the scan, then press Save.
course.edit.saveBlock.tooFarStart: The start is too far from the scan to save. Move it back towards the scan, then press Save.
course.fix.moved: Gates moved to free places: {n} (gates {gates}). Their old places are shown dashed.
course.fix.none: No gate could be moved to a better place.
course.fix.undone: Every moved gate is back. Press Save to keep the course this way.
course.edit.saveOpenedWarned: Course opened, gates: {n}. Some gates have warnings (a wall or another gate too near): press Save to see them or fix them all in one press.
